title: Christian Watson's new $110.5 million deal shows how much Packers believe in his ceiling

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Christian Watson's new $110.5 million deal shows how much Packers believe in his ceiling
sources.description: Green Bay just made Christian Watson one of the NFL's highest-paid receivers, betting that his elite efficiency and a larger role in a reshaped wideout room will outweigh the durability questions
